highlights: Result Update 5th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 2,900 Endurance Technologies Ltd Auto Ancillary 1 Strong Order Pipeline, EV Scale-Up, and Capacity Expansion Drive Growth Visibility Est.

Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – BEAT; EBITDA – MISS; PAT – BEAT Change in Estimates Post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: 6.9%/8.2%; EBITDA: -5.6%/-4.3%; PAT: -8.1%/-5.4% Recommendation Rationale • Strategic Capacity Expansion & Premiumisation Driving Sustainable Growth: Endurance is expanding capacities across key product categories to support rising OEM demand and premiumisation.

These capacity additions, backed by existing OEM commitments and new programme wins, are expected to strengthen revenue visibility and support long-term growth across 2W, 4W and EV segments. • EV Ecosystem & Proprietary Product Expansion Strengthening Growth Visibility: Standalone India EV revenue grew 185% YoY to Rs 229 Cr in Q2FY27, contributing 5% to sales.
Endurance commenced 2W battery pack supplies to a leading OEM, with peak volumes expected in Q3FY27, while two 4W OEM nominations are scheduled for SOP in Q1FY28 and Q2FY28.
